sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aim of this module is to provide students with detailed knowledge of the organic chemistry of biological systems. The module will provide insights into important metabolic pathways.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Characterize different organic compounds using different spectroscopic techniques (MS, IR, UV-Vis, and NMR) B. Understand and discuss common mechanisms in Biological Chemistry C. Understand and explain the structures and reactions of biomolecules from a chemical point of view D. Understand chemical mechanisms of enzymes-catalyzed reactions E. Solve simple theoretical problems in Biological Chemistry
